english.title: Remote pilot fly unmanned aircraft in flight restriction zone without permission
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the remote pilot of an unmanned aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), flew that aircraft in the flight restriction zone of a protected aerodrome, namely **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..), when the permissions required for that flight under Article 94A(4) of the Air Navigation Order 2016 had not been obtained
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 94A(1)(b) and (4) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
